EDR_232 captures original affectable board minions in owner-board order once. Each finite automatic native callback first checks original reference before any random draw; a second native two-option random choice binds exactly that original minion and recipient. It rechecks original residence immediately before one ShuffleDeckCards semantic group with ShuffleIntoDeck. Stale targets skip without replacement; later new board minions are not admitted. Native shuffle resets/control/ownership/hidden knowledge, source issuer, insertion RNG and per-card shuffle history remain public.

Capacity/quantities/current scene and new-body material remain ordinary resurrection; new deaths do not enlarge original accepted inventory.
